summary: Ruben Abrica supported a ceasefire resolution by April 2024 and voted against East Palo Alto's resolution endorsing the IHRA definition, per CAIR-SFBA's tracker and CAM's report of the 3–2 vote. CAIR Action endorsed him for the general election, and Vote for Peace rated him an Ally. Together these actions and recommendations mark him as an early local advocate for Palestinian justice.
